messages:
Carmen R.: heads up, i've got a last-minute thing — need to swap primary for the 20:00-04:00 window tonight. i can hand off now if someone can take primary for the period. low risk unless the embed queue flares up, but want coverage.
ops-incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT #4492 — high error rate on /v1/embeddings (5xx spike). PAGER sent to @oncall. link: https://incidents.redwood/4492 — severity: sev2 — affected: batch embedding workers (possible queue backlog).
Carmen R.: also posting the short checklist below for whoever picks up. i'll stay reachable for 30m while i finish the transfer.
Alice M.: i can take primary for that slot, 20:00-04:00. will shadow for the next 15. @ben can you be secondary?
Ben K.: yes i can be secondary. i'll be on standby and can take over if pager noise increases.
Dave L.: quick q — any customer-impact right now? telemetry dashboards looked noisy earlier but dropped.
sre-bot: Event summary: 21:10 UTC — embedding workers latency > 2s, 5xx rate peaked at 4.7% for 2m, queue depth increased by 18%. Auto-scaling triggered but warm-up lagged. No 3rd-party failures detected.
Carmen R.: thanks. customer impact: a handful of large-batch jobs got delayed ~30–90s earlier, no 4xx/5xx directly returned to clients we know of, but the delay caused retry storms on one partner integration. i filed a quick postmortem note in the incident doc.
Alice M.: ok i'll start the handoff. Carmen, please paste the runbook i'm usually terrible at remembering the exact checkpoint names.
Carmen R.: runbook link: https://confluence.redwood/runbooks/embed-queue — key steps i run:
```
1. check queue depth: prod/embed-queue /metrics
2. if backlog > 500, scale group 'embeds-workers' +2 instance and watch warmup
3. check autoscaler logs: /var/log/autoscaler.log
4. if 5xx persist > 5m, flip routing to compat-quantized model via routing policy (route id: embed-fallback)
5. notify customers via status page if >10min impact
```
Alice M.: copied. i'll kick off a warmup scale now and monitor. Ben, you'll own pager escalation if it gets noisy, call out if you need me to take back primary.
Ben K.: got it. i set a slack reminder for 30m to check queue. if latency >2s for sustained 3m i'll escalate.
Dave L.: can someone post the quick commands? i might need to run some checks.
Alice M.: commands i use: `kubectl get hpa -n prod embeds-workers` then `kubectl top pods -n prod -l app=embeds` and `curl -sS https://telemetry/api/queues/embed-queue | jq .depth` — i'll paste a short shell snippet here.
Alice M.: ```
# warmup 2 instances
kubectl scale deployment/embeds-workers -n prod --replicas=$(($(kubectl get deployment embeds-workers -n prod -o jsonpath='{.spec.replicas}')+2))
# check queue
curl -sS https://telemetry/api/queues/embed-queue | jq .depth
# tail autoscaler
kubectl logs -n prod deploy/autoscaler -c scaler --since=10m | tail -n 200
```
Carmen R.: perfect. also: if you need to roll to compat-quantized model, use the console route: Console → Routing → embed-fallback and set weight 100% for up to 10m, then monitor. fallback model id: rw-embed-compat-v1.
Alice M.: scaling is in progress, queue depth trending down from 420 -> 180 in the last 4m. latency 95th pctl dropped from 2.4s -> 1.1s.
Ben K.: nice. i'll keep on pager for contingency. Carmen, confirm you still plan to be available via DM for 30m after handoff?
Carmen R.: yes i'll be reachable on my phone and slack DMs until 20:45 my time. thanks everyone.
ops-incident-bot: NOTE: incident #4492 updated — auto-scaling action executed by Alice M. monitoring continues.
Alice M.: last note for the handoff: on-call checklist executed -> warmed +2 embeds-workers, routed fallback not needed, alerted partner ops to the transient delays. i'm primary now. Ben secondary.
Ben K.: acknowledged. i logged the swap in the oncall calendar.
Dave L.: thanks. i'll close my monitoring loop but ping if anything odd.
Carmen R.: handing off — over to you, @Alice. good luck :thumbsup:
